findings.issue: Removing more units than are in stock silently creates a negative quantity instead of raising ValueError as specified.
findings.fix: Before decrementing, compare qty with item.qty and raise ValueError when qty exceeds current stock.
findings.evidence: Direct boundary check removed 3 from stock of 2 and produced qty=-1 with no exception.

findings.issue: Items exactly at the low-stock threshold are excluded, although the specification requires qty <= threshold.
findings.fix: Change the comparison from < threshold to <= threshold.
findings.evidence: With quantities 1, 2, and 3 at threshold 2, the method returned only the quantity-1 SKU.
